candidates.evidence: Two dominant lines at 388.3 cm-1 (E2g^1, FWHM ~6.2) and 413.5 cm-1 (A1g, FWHM ~6.6) with a separation of ~25.3 cm-1, matching the MoS2 doublet. The separation is bulk-like (≥4 layers). No other strong lines.
Same E/A doublet positions, so the polytype can't be excluded from this spectrum. The 2H polytype is the common default.
Its A1g is at ~241 cm-1 and E2g at ~287 cm-1. Nothing is seen there, so it is rejected.

hint_reasoning: No material hint was given, so the identification rests on the spectrum alone.

peaks.source: Lorentzian fit of this spectrum. The mode assignment is from Lee et al., ACS Nano 4, 2695 (2010) and Zhang et al., Chem. Soc. Rev. 44, 2757 (2015).
Lorentzian fit of this spectrum. The mode assignment is from Lee et al., ACS Nano 4, 2695 (2010). Polarization pattern is not assessed because this is a single unpolarized spectrum.

peaks.assignment: Possible weak shoulder, tentatively a defect or disorder-related feature or a background wiggle
peaks.source: Three-Lorentzian fit. Amplitude uncertainty is >100%, so this is not a reliable peak.

properties.name: layer number
properties.value: Bulk-like, roughly ≥4 layers. The A1g−E2g separation is ~25.3 cm-1 (monolayer ~18-19, bilayer ~21-22, bulk ~25).

properties.name: A1g/E2g peak-height ratio
properties.value: ~0.32 (E2g stronger). This depends on the focus and orientation conditions.

properties.name: strain/doping
properties.value: Not quantified. The E2g position is close to the unstrained bulk value (~383-386 in some reports, up to ~388 here), and no reference was measured.

citations: Lee, C. et al. Anomalous lattice vibrations of single- and few-layer MoS2. ACS Nano 4, 2695 (2010)
Zhang, X. et al. Phonon and Raman scattering of two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides from monolayer, multilayer to bulk material. Chem. Soc. Rev. 44, 2757 (2015)
limits: This is a single unpolarized spectrum, so polarization patterns and symmetry classification can't be tested.
The layer count is estimated only from the E2g-A1g separation (25.3 cm-1), which saturates at about 4 layers or more. The data can't separate a thick flake from bulk.
The 2H and 3R polytypes can't be told apart from this E2g/A1g pair alone. Low-frequency shear and breathing modes below 60 cm-1 are outside the measured range (60-1099 cm-1).
The weak features (LA(M) ~227, 2LA(M) ~450, and a possible shoulder near 363) are not significant against the noise (σ ≈ 200 counts), so they are not reported as peaks.
No Si substrate line near 520.7 cm-1 is visible, so the substrate is unidentified and no wavenumber calibration check against Si was possible.
The single-point spike at 1063.3 cm-1 was rejected as a cosmic ray, not a Raman peak.
Strain and doping can't be determined without a reference.
